h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Morbi

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Morbi

c: Morbi's ceramic tile and sanitaryware factories run around the clock, and many of them have large compounds and worker housing nearby. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Morbi for these factories as well as schools, residential societies and the municipality. We make our machines at our Vasai factory, about 440 km away, and send them to Saurashtra by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in western India fixes them on site. Morbi is hot and dry for most of the year, with a short monsoon and strong winds before it arrives. Ceramic dust is a fact of life near the kilns, so we suggest a paved base that is easy to sweep and a site upwind of the factory sheds. A layout drawing with clear space marked comes before any manufacturing.

items.q: Can a ceramic factory in Morbi install an outdoor gym for staff?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the space, the number of workers per shift and where the dust is heaviest. We will suggest a set and place it on the layout drawing away from the kilns.

items.q: How often should we clean machines near a factory?
items.a: Sweep the base and wipe the handles and joints every week if dust is heavy. Report any stiff or noisy joint to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.

items.q: Is the 6 Station Multi Gym suitable for a small compound?
items.a: It needs a clear circle around the frame. For a narrow strip, separate machines in a row work better. Send us the dimensions and we will suggest the right option.
